sanskrit_verse: प्रतिसंवत्सरं सोमः पशुः प्रत्ययनं तथा । कर्तव्याग्रयणेष्टिश् च चातुर्मास्यानि चैव हि ॥
transliteration: pratisaṃvatsaraṃ somaḥ paśuḥ pratyayanaṃ tathā / kartavyāgrayaṇeṣṭiś ca cāturmāsyāni caiva hi //
sph_interpretive_translation: The Somayaga must be performed annually; likewise, the animal sacrifice and the Pratyayana ritual. The Kartavyagrahana Yajna and the quarterly rituals (Chaturmasya) are also to be conducted without fail.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Ritual performance is mandated by Vedic injunction, establishing divine sovereignty through ceremonial action.
Causation: Regular observance ensures cosmic order and spiritual alignment of the performer with universal dharma.
Capacity-based responsibility: The duty to perform yajnas lies with those initiated and capable of maintaining purity and intent.
Restoration logic: Omission disrupts harmony; completion restores it.
Consciousness alignment: Ritual repetition aligns individual awareness with eternal rhythms.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent_is_diksha_upadhita AND time_elapsed >= 1 solar_year THEN execute_somayaga = TRUE
IF pratyayana_date_occurred AND NOT performed THEN trigger_consciousness_realignment_process = TRUE
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning religious practice and state-supported ritual omission, the Supreme Court must assess whether the omission was due to willful neglect or capacity failure. Restoration occurs through supervised completion under qualified guidance, not punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that yajña omission distorts karmic causality. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how neglect leads to misalignment. Responsibility is proportional to initiation level. Non-punitive rule: correction via guided re-performance restores ontological balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Assign qualified priest to oversee delayed yajñas.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Initiate must affirm conscious intent before resuming.
Capacity Restoration: Provide resources for ritual materials and purification.
Integrity Reintegration: Conduct preparatory ceremonies to restore spiritual readiness.
final_declaration: This directive flows from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is restored through proper ritual execution. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the final adjudicator.
